findings.title: Flask 3.0.3 affected by CVE-2026-27205 (Vary: Cookie header not set on session access)
findings.description: The pinned version of Flask (3.0.3) is affected by a vulnerability in which the framework fails to set the `Vary: Cookie` header when the session object is accessed. Without this header, intermediate caches may serve a response intended for one user/session to another, potentially exposing session-scoped data.
findings.evidence: pip-audit reports flask@3.0.3 is affected by CVE-2026-27205, GHSA-68rp-wp8r-4726.
findings.remediation: Upgrade flask to a fixed version (3.1.3 or later) in requirements.txt and rebuild the dependency lockfile.
